title: Thank you for the feedback. I have made some changes...
author: RISOvonVODKA
selftext:
Hey! So here is a little gameplay from my phone. I have made some changes to how I built my assets and maps. Now, mostly by hand with custom 2D/3D aplication that allows me to draw, place assets,  rotate or change parts of the map with generative AI, and then adjust it by hand. 

Here is the first mission with a bit of a story. Dusk has an ability yo corrupt the ground she takes. There are tendrils growing from her buildings and vines connecting them. The ground also changes appearance to show the corruption. 

After retaking the building, the light will heal the ground, but it takes longer (just like in real life).
